description: This file defines a PHP interface 'UriFactoryInterface' within the 'Psr\Http\Message' namespace. The interface declares a method for creating URI instances, adhering to the PSR-17 HTTP Factories standard.

classes.name: UriFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for creating URI instances, providing a method to generate new URIs from strings.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a new UriInterface instance from the provided URI string, or an empty string by default.
